summary.result: From the result, a instrument system that can accurately estimate a change of pore water pressure shall be established for a rational maintenance and stabilization of raising embankment for agricultural reservoir.
summary.background: In this study, an experiment with large-scale model was performed according to raising embankment in order to investigate the cause of collapse by a change in water level of reservoir.
summary.method: In a rapid drawdown, inclined core was remained stable but vertical core showed a largely change in pore water pressure.
